issue.body:
Hi,
I stumbled upon a quirk in starlette that is not properly documented. It seems like all of my HTTP request to a route without trailing slash are being redirected to route with trailing slashes. Say I am hitting `http://hostname/mountpoint/api` it will be redirected (302) to `http://hostname/mountpoint/api/`. This messed up your api calls; if you call POST to `http://hostname/mountpoint/api` it will be redirected to GET `http://hostname/mountpoint/api/`.

I dig on the source and see this redirect_slashes flag and setting it to False fix this. I feel this behavior (the auto redirection) should be documented.
issue.title: Use "308 Permanent Redirect" for redirect slashes behavior.
